chapters.content:
1972, spring and summer, Harbor City.
At twilight, the sun is sinking in the west, on both sides of the street, the traffic is like weaving, there are well-dressed modern men and women talking and laughing, there are also squatting on the side of the road side of the ragged poor people waiting to sell labor, like this prosperous metropolis, one side of the decay, the other side of the bloom.
With a creak, a rickshaw came to a stop at the side of the road.
The car down is a teenager, seventeen or eighteen years old appearance, because the body is too thin, the body of the wrinkled white shirt, will appear empty. His thin body, is a pale as paper face, even the lips can not see a trace of blood color, the whole person through a weak sick face.
Because of this sick face, at first glance Xing may not realize, but if a little square eyes, will find that this is actually a very handsome young man. The face is a long face, a pair of thick black deep eyebrows, straight nose, lips - even the pale lips have a good-looking curvature.
Unfortunately, it looked so frail, even staggering as if he were about to fall when he got out of the car, that it was hard to appreciate how handsome he was born.
At least the rickshaw driver didn't have the heart for it.
Seeing that he really looked like he was about to return to the west at any moment, the driver originally wanted to ask with concern, but was afraid of getting into trouble - after all, what the poor people feared most was trouble. So after accepting the money he handed over, he thanked him and hurriedly pulled the car and ran away.
Qiaowen felt that now he really does not look like a serious living person, after all, just "back from the dead".
The weakness is also really bad, but it's always good to be alive.
He slowly walked to the sidewalk, turned to look across the street, there is a teahouse, hanging in the air on the hot gold signboard, written "Hibiscus Tea Room" four big words.
If there are no accidents, tonight in this teahouse, a nineteen year old young man will stab a rich merchant in the city to death, and from then on change his own fate and that of the rich merchant's young son.
And the reason why Qiaowen knew in advance about this bloodshed that was about to happen tonight was not because he had precognitive ability, but because he was in a novel world at the moment.
The young man who is about to kill is the villain of the novel, and the son of the rich merchant is the hero.
As for Jovian himself, or the original owner of the body he's in today, he's the arch-villain's best friend from childhood, a tiny cannon fodder who originally died of an illness today.
The character is so insignificant in the book that he doesn't even make a positive appearance because he dies so early, and only ever exists in the villain's memories.
Yes, Jovian is a book wearer.
Crossing over from the year 2020 to this novel set in a 1970s harbor city, he becomes a minor supporting character in the book with the same name as him.
*
Go back in time a day, early fall of 2020, in a desert in the west.
The desert night was already very slightly cooler in the July fire, and the campground was already asleep, so that deep breathing could be faintly heard from the nearby tents.
Qiao Wen was guarding the campfire, and had just saved the fire when he heard someone rustle up next to him and come up to him and whisper, "Brother Wen, do you smoke?"
Qiao Wen turned his head and saw that it was the young boy wearing glasses in the camping team. He and this hiking camping team, only met during the day, do not know what the boy's name, only to hear him call himself a geek, this time out because the house for a long time, want to experience life, which know just follow the team hiking for two days, in the desert lost their way.
"Thanks." Jovian took the cigarette from the boy's hand and lit it on his lips over the campfire, smiling, "What's the matter? Can't sleep?"
A cool night breeze blew, and the boy couldn't help but rub his arms, saying, "It's dark everywhere here, there's no people at all, it's weirdly scary."
Jovian asked, "First time in the desert?"
The boy nodded, "Originally that leader said he was very experienced, so I signed up, I didn't expect to get lost after walking for more than a day, luckily I met you, or else I might have gotten into some trouble." Said another sincere, "I really admire you actually dare to hike across the desert alone."
Jovian laughed and shook his head, "It's nothing more than a few more tries."
He looked up into the distance, the vast vault of the stars, a glimpse of the desert, hidden in the darkness, so quiet that only the sound of the wind from nowhere, who knows how many dangers are hidden in that dark place.
And danger is always fascinating.
The boy, on the other hand, was unmoving as he surveyed him; the group had been bouncing around like headless flies during the day, and when they saw that they were about to run out of drinking water, this young man had come out of nowhere to lead them to a water source and then camped nearby.
He didn't know his identity, but only knew that he was an experienced hiker with superior physical strength and a calm mind, and very well equipped, so he should be quite rich. In fact, most of the people who love adventure are looking for excitement because they don't lack money.
And he was still handsome, and in the light of the campfire, the handsome face with a bit of stubble had an almost distorted handsomeness to it.
Not caring about the boy's measuring gaze, Qiaowen smiled at him and casually said, "Or else you could just snooze by the campfire? I'll be next to you, no need to be afraid."
The boy was thinking just that, "Then call me when you're sleepy and I'll watch the fire with you for a shift."
Jovian hooked his lower lip, noncommittal.
The boy spread the blanket underneath him, wrapped his windbreaker around him and lay back down, and then, as if remembering something, pulled out the kindle he had with him and handed it to Jovian, "If you're bored, read a novel to pass the time."
The long night was indeed boring, and Jovian took it and casually opened the first book on the shelf.
The Great Lords of the Seventies.
I can tell by the name that it's internet cool writing for YA.
Qiaowen seldom read online, but thinking that waiting for the gang to wake up and replace themselves would probably take until dawn, he clicked on it in boredom and started reading to kill time.
By the time he saw that villain in the story being shot randomly by the protagonist, the sky was finally showing fish-belly white, and the people in the tent were waking up one after another.
He returned the kindle to the waking boy.
The boy rubbed his face and took it, asking casually, "What are you reading?"
Jovian said, "Just the first one on your bookshelf."
The boy said, "That web novel. By the way--" Suddenly remembering something, he laughed and said, "There's a character in it with the same name as you."
"Yeah? I didn't notice." Jovian passed the time, scribbling, not noticing that there was a minor supporting character with the same name as his own in the book.
The boy thought to be a fan of the novel, chatting about this, then came to interest: "It is the villain Chen Canaan that early death of the hair small, only appeared in the memories. Back then, the two families were poor, this hair little born seriously ill can not afford to go to a major hospital, Chen Canaan in order to give him to earn medical fees, go to assassinate the hero father. But by the time he finished killing, this hairy boy had already died in the black clinic in Kowloon Walled City. Chen Canaan is greatly stimulated by this and goes down a crooked path of doing whatever he can for money."
After he reminded him, Qiao Wen remembered that there was indeed such a minor supporting character, who was gone before the story started, just a character who appeared in the memories of the villain Chen Canaan, so he didn't care about the name.
Originally it was nothing more than a cool book to pass the time, and this kind of crappy plot was really nothing special. Just by the boy's description, he was suddenly slightly moved by the friendship of the villain in the book.
Because he also happens to have a hairdresser who can put his life on the line for him, and even has the word Nan in his name.
One after another, the others came over to greet them, interrupting their small talk.
The group simply washed up, ate some dry food, and set off on the road before the sun rose. By noon, Qiao Wen sent them to the nearest highway, and he himself went on the road alone to continue the unfinished desert journey.
Since Lin Nan's absence, all the adventures and journeys the two had once planned together could only be accomplished by him alone.
This desert journey was his last stop, and when it was over, he would return to the earthly smoke and fire and live his life as well as Lin Nan wished him to.
But as fate would have it, just halfway through this desert journey, Jovan is caught in a sandstorm.
The yellow sand swept up from the sky, and he was soon buried in the sand, his breathing became harder and harder, and in the end, his whole body was plunged into a sinking darkness.
He knew he was going to die.
I just don't know if I'll be able to see Lin Nan after I die.
*
"Arwen! Arwen! Wake up, don't die!"
The piercing howl shook the eardrums, and combined with the violent shaking of his body, pulled Jovian back from his suffocation.
A fishy heat leapt up from his throat, forcing him to cough heavily, followed by gasping for air while breathing hard, like a drowning man regaining air, the choking sensation finally relieved.
"Arwen, you ...... you're not dead?"
Qiao Wen lifted his eyelids with difficulty, and a snotty, unfamiliar teenager appeared in his vision, holding his shoulders and shaking them violently. He finally realized why he was just as seasick as he was just now, it was because he was shaken so hard by this kid.
He took two deep breaths, eased up a little, and spoke in a muffled voice, "Howie, are you calling for your soul?"
Howie?
Jovian leapt to his feet, not only because he had blurted out the name of this strange teenager, but because he was clearly speaking a mouthful of Cantonese.
Just as he was stunned and bewildered, suddenly a tidal wave of memories that didn't belong to him flooded his mind.
After a moment, he looked around incredulously.
This is a dimly lit small house, he thought he had seen a lot, but he had never seen such a simple and dilapidated house in his lifetime. Yellowish walls, a small window with half broken glass, a few tables and chairs inside the house that hadn't even been painted, a few black ceramic pots for boiling medicines on the table, and the whole house emitting the pungent smell of a mixture of various medicines.
An old sit-down fan was on a nearby table, cackling and spinning.
Dark, damp, stuffy, dirty ......
The memory that had just flooded him told him that this was a clinic, a black clinic belonging to the seventies, in the Kowloon Walled City of Hong Kong.
Seeing him wake up, Howie finally let go of his hands that were holding his shoulders and shaking them furiously, wiped his eyes, and excitedly howled out towards the outside, "Uncle Wah! You come quickly, Man is awake!"
As soon as his words fell, a thin old man in his fifties or sixties lifted the curtain from outside.
This person was born with a round nose and small eyes, with a long beard, wearing a cap of melon skin popular in the Republican period, not like a doctor, but like a fortune-teller under the flyover stall.
He walked over incredulously, reached out and lifted Qiao Wen's, frowned and looked carefully, and then grabbed his wrist, one side of the pulse one side of his wide pair of soybean eyes, incredibly smacked his lips: "Strange, strange, just now clearly has stopped the heartbeat of the air, how to come back to life?"
Beside him, Howie stopped wailing and turned to choking, saying brokenly, "Uncle Wah, I was almost scared to death when you just said that Man had gone."
Qiao Wen honestly leaned back and sat on this wooden-framed cot underneath him, allowing this old Chinese doctor to practice looking and sniffing on himself, while his mind silently digested the new memories he had just obtained and organized the current situation.
Obviously he was in the desert and encountered a sandstorm, how come he came to this strange place as soon as he opened his eyes?
Fortunately, he had just read the online book called "The Great Lords of the Seventies", so he was rather quick to ascertain that, out of some metaphysical power, he, who was supposed to have died in a sandstorm, was reborn in this fictional world, turning into the cannon fodder with the same name as him in the book, that is, the big villain, Chen Canaan, who had hiccuped early as a good brother.
The world is Hong Kong City in the early seventies - called Hong Kong City in the book, the corresponding real world is actually the chaotic yet prosperous Hong Kong in the seventies.
He ran through the timeline in his mind.
He remembers that when Chen Canaan died, the author describes his past journey in a big way, and the most important piece of reminiscence is the day his brother Qiao Wen, who he grew up with, died.
This world's Qiao Wen grew up a sick child, eighteen years old that year was born a serious illness, in the Kowloon Walled City of the broken clinic lay for several days, medicine and stone to no avail, was told by the boss must be transferred to the big foreign hospital treatment. However, at that time the two were poor children of Kowloon Walled City, where the money to go to a large hospital.
In order to earn money for Qiao Wen's medication, Chen Canan takes a killing mission from a club boss, and the target of the assassination is none other than the hero Lin Zi Hui's own father.
It was his first kill, and he did it well, yet when he ran back with the money, ready to take Jovan to the Oceanic Hospital, the teenager lying on the shabby cot in the black clinic had long since gone cold and hard.
That was the darkest moment of Chen Canaan's life, and it was from then on that he vowed to get ahead and make a lot of money, and from then on he embarked on a path of no return as a villainous villain, which became the source of his tragic ending later on.
If he wasn't mistaken, today was the day Qiao Wen died, and also the turning point of Chen Canaan's fate. Combined with how Howie just grabbed the original body and shook it violently and howled like a ghost, as well as the reaction of the old Chinese doctor, Uncle Hua, the Qiao Wen of this world should have originally died, only for this body to come back to life because of the entry of his own soul.
The original Jovian became him.
But anyway, he who originally died in the desert was reborn as another person in another world.
He had promised Lin Nan that he would live well, even if he had changed worlds, changed identities and shells, but it was always good to be alive.

Qiao Wen was a natural adventurer at heart, and after Lin Nan passed away in order to save himself, he had traveled alone to many dangerous places. Therefore, he did not feel too uneasy about coming to this foreign world at first glance.
Uncle Hua was sure that he had survived, and although he was still surprised, he was relieved and said, "His pulse is much smoother, I'll boil some more medicine for you, Howie, you feed Man some hot water, and get a portion of the chicken velvet congee, so that he can eat something to renew his life in a hurry."
Howie hmmm'd and scrambled to pour a cup of warm water and bring it to Jovian's mouth.
This child also do not know whether it is born will not take care of people, or just be scared, hands and feet in a mess wet a large part of Qiao Wen lapel, favor Qiao Wen a little strength can not make on, can only endure him this rough and clumsy feeding.
Water really is the source of life.
After gulping down half a cup of it, Qiaowen instantly felt a lot more comfortable in this frail body.
Howie wiped his eyes almost tears of joy at seeing him drink so much water, huffing and puffing as he got up and prepared to run out for hot porridge.
Just before the person left the bedside, he was grabbed by Qiaowen's pale right hand that was as thin as a chicken claw, "Wait!"
I don't know how weak this body is in the end, just such a small action, Qiao Wen almost didn't take a breath, and the voice that barely spoke, was also breathless.
"What's wrong Man?" Howie asked hurriedly, "You've been passed out in bed for a few days and haven't eaten a thing, I'll buy you some congee to fill your stomach right away."
It turned out that he hadn't eaten for a few days, so it was no wonder that the original body had died, even if it wasn't from disease, it had to starve to death.
He took two hard breaths and asked, "Where's Nan?"
Howie said, "Uncle Wah said you have to go to a foreign hospital outside for this disease, we don't have enough money, Nan went to raise money for your medicine."
Qiaowen had inherited the original body's memories and had read most of the original text, and still remembered the plot.
In front of this young man called Ho Chai, his first name is Chen Xiaohao, is Chen Canaan grew up together with his cousin, but also his future beloved, not very bold ability is also general, but the character of the loyal and honest, his cousin can be said to be loyal to him.
Listening to his answer, Qiao Wen knew that he had guessed correctly, Chen Canaan this is in order to raise medical expenses for the original body to kill people, except that Howie clearly did not know the truth, only thought that ordinary raise money.
Qiao Wen had the memories of his original body, so he naturally knew what kind of person the original sickly Qiao Wen was.
Although born in the Kowloon Walled City this kind of fish and dragons mixed slums, but Qiao Wen nature of goodness, has always been very opposed to Chen Canaan mixing clubs, in his memory, although Chen Canaan impulsive and reckless temperament, fighting and brawling is commonplace, but is not a bad boy, on the contrary, the character of the integrity of the rather chivalrous and righteous.
The sickly young man who was no longer there would have been saddened to learn that his Nan had gone off to kill people for money for himself, and had been on a path from then on that eventually led to his death by random gunfire at a young age, I'm sure.
Qiao Wen thought to himself that since he had borrowed his body to be reborn, he should always do something for him.
According to the theory of the butterfly effect, his arrival had brought to life Qiaowen, who had originally died today, and there should be a good chance that the fate of the others would change from then on as well.
Besides, he had always believed that he was in charge of his own destiny.
It was only that this body was currently too bad, not to mention trying to figure out how to stop Chen Canaan, it was difficult to even get out of this black clinic.
Still have to eat first to get some energy.
He let go of Howie's hand and said, "Go get it, get two, and come back soon."
Howie these days followed the cousin every day to take care of Qiao Wen, at first Wen can still eat a little, to these two days, is even water can not drink, Uncle Hua said that people to the water can not drink, is incurable, let them hurry to send to the foreign hospitals, may still be able to save back.
However, the foreign hospital is expensive, pay money first before acceptance, they did not even come up with a fraction of the money, cousin said he will get the money tonight, let him keep a good eye on Wen, just saw Wen no air, he almost did not die of fear.
I don't know how Man came back from the dead, but it's good to be alive.
I wonder how things are going with my cousin.
Howie rubbed his head in confusion, having just cried and swooned his way out the door.
Jovian closed his eyes and sat back against the bed waiting for the food that would save his life.
Howie couldn't take care of people, but he was pretty good at running errands, and in just a few minutes, he returned with two steaming bowls of congee, "Ah Man, eat quickly. Uncle Wah said that as long as you can eat, you'll be fine."
Because Qiaowen's resurrection from the dead had filled the seventeen year old teenage boy with so much energy that he couldn't wait to dunk the two bowls of porridge into Qiaowen in one gulp.
Jovian ate half of it, slowed down, couldn't stand the bratty kid any longer, took the bowl from his hand, shook his weak hand, and physically handicapped himself with a hearty meal.
Jovian wasn't able to feel what exactly was wrong with this body, or perhaps it was because of his arrival that the original illness had inexplicably dissipated, leaving him with only tangible weakness and severe hunger.
He couldn't even taste too well how this Chicken Mushroom Porridge really tasted, just desperately wanting to fill his empty stomach. The two bowls of congee were eaten cleanly, finally barely feeling full.
Because of these two bowls of hot congee, Qiao Wen's pale and frail face finally floated a layer of not-so-obvious blood color with great difficulty, and his originally lifeless black eyes also brightened a few points.
In short, you can be sure to return from the netherworld to the yangworld as a great living being.
Howie is not very smart, but also quite a bit of observation. He and Qiao Wen grew up together, not to mention the time of illness, is the body of a decent day, Wen is always sickly, with a glass man in general, as if with a touch of the hand will be shattered to the west, at this time, although it still looks weak, but the expression of the eyes is clearly with the weekdays are completely different.
Howie couldn't tell where it was different, staring wide-eyed at Qiao Wen, racking his brain, finally pulling a word out of his uneducated mind, and instantly shocking himself again, he sat crookedly on the ground with a plop and howled, "Wen, you're not coming back to life, are you?"
Jovian: "......" The book is true, the kid really isn't very bright.
Not waiting for him to answer, Uncle Hua had already walked in and slapped Howie on the top of the head, "Bad boy, mourning again!" He looked at the two clean lunchboxes next to him and said, "Being able to eat means you're fine, don't scare yourself."
Howie finally stopped wailing again and stood up with a sniffle.
Two bowls of porridge under the belly to return the Yang, Qiao Wen finally have the energy to consider the reality again.
He looked around the room and his eyes landed on the aged wall clock on the dull yellow wall, the hands of which were pointing at five o'clock in the afternoon.
The book wrote that the day the hero Lin Zihui's father died was when the father and son were having evening tea, and that had to be seven or eight o'clock in the evening before Chen Canaan made his move.
He still has time.
thought, the man had gotten out of bed.
Seeing this, Ho Chai stepped forward to help him, and said in a panic, "Ah Man, what do you want? Just tell me what you want, you just woke up, lie down and recuperate."
The moment he stepped onto the ground, Qiaowen only felt both of his legs go completely uncontrollably soft, but fortunately, Howie held himself up.
After panting for a while with both eyes blacked out, he finally managed to catch his breath.
Although I know that the original body has just returned from the ghost gate, this body ...... is not too weak.
Qiaowen grew up with a healthy body and developed athletic ability, but now that he had gotten such a skin, he was not used to it for a while.
However, he also knew that this situation should be due to the fact that he had been lying in bed for a long time.
After sitting on the edge of the bed for a while to calm down, Qiaowen tried to get up again, and although it was still a bit of a struggle, he was barely able to move freely.
Seeing that he was about to walk out, Howie held him up and said urgently, "Mann, don't move, if anything happens again, my brother will come back and have to kill me."
Qiaowen smiled softly at him and said, "I'm fine, it's just really hard to lie down for a long time, I need to get out and move around."
Outside, Uncle Hua said in a loud voice, "That's right, it's time to move around and let the qi and blood flow, which will be beneficial to the body's recovery."
Howie sniffed and finally stopped obsessing and nodded, "Okay, I'll stay with you."
Qiao Wen did not immediately refuse, and with his assistance, lifted the cloth curtain in the inner room and slowly walked out. Uncle Hua in the outer room, was sitting behind the table taking the pulse of an old woman with a withered description, hearing the two men move, his eyes flicked up, slanting his eyes, the old god commanded, "Come back early to drink the medicine."
"Okay Uncle Wah."
Qiaowen continued to walk outside, subconsciously looking up as he passed a mirror in the house, then was slightly stunned.
The original body in the book only exists in Chen Canaan's memory, almost no positive description, only know is a childhood in the pot of medicine soaked up the sick child, as for what looks like, completely unknown.
The mirror was a bit old, and the surface was not very clean, but Qiao Wen could still see the original body's face clearly. Even though his face was full of disease and so thin that he had lost his looks, he could still see the declining sun in his features. Long eyebrows and long eyes, dark eyes scooped up a pool of water, high and straight nose, thin lips with a little natural upward curvature, is a standard wind and weak willow beautiful man looks.
Qiaowen sighed inwardly and walked out of the not-so-big door of Uncle Wah's clinic with Howie's assistance.
Accompanied by a stench of corruption and a wave of humid heat that hit his face, as far as Qiaowen's eyes could see, there were crowded, cramped and dilapidated tenement buildings, as well as a mishmash of dirty, narrow streets and alleys.
It was still a bright day, yet the densely packed buildings and half-empty power lines blocked most of the light, making this a shadowy place where the sun didn't shine.
Kowloon Walled City, where Canaan Chan and Qiao Wen grew up, was also the most famous slum in Hong Kong City before the 1990s.
A city entrenched in the heart of the city, the legendary Sin City.

Due to the historical legacy, for a long time, the Kowloon Walled City has been an "unregulated" area which has been neglected by both the Chinese and the British Governments. It has long been dominated by triad societies, and the prevalence of pornography, gambling and drug abuse has made this area of less than three hectares synonymous with poverty and criminality in a special era. wouldn't even come in.
In reality, the Kowloon Walled City was demolished to build a park in 1993, and Qiao Wen had not seen the famous slum with his own eyes. But the legends about it have endured in later generations, becoming a source of inspiration for many artists and even turning into a mecca for cyberpunk enthusiasts for a time.
At that moment, an airplane from Kai Tak Airport rumbled past the roof of the adjacent tenement building, casting a large shadow.
Jovan recalls how William Gibson, the father of cyberpunk, described it - "The Citadel stands at the end of a runway, waiting to be cleared. It had been home to butchers, unlicensed dentists and drug dealers ...... Those cluttered windows were like nests of dreams; they seemed to absorb all the mad vitality of the Kai Tak airport; they sucked up energy like black holes."
It's a city within a city that has given inspiration to countless creators, but there's a fundamental difference between literary creation and real life.
When being at this point, even an adventurer like Jovan felt an oppression and uneasiness that could not be dispersed.
After all, he was born under the red flag and grew up under the red flag, his family was well off, never suffered materially, and his adventures were all desert jungles and the like, and he never went deep into the real slums.
And now, not only is he deeper, he's part of it.
It can be very ...... exciting.
He calculated in his mind that it was 1972, the last two years before the Walled City was inhabited by the Patrol Police, which meant that it was still the darkest years of the Kowloon Walled City.
It was a good thing that he had inherited both the memories of his original body and knew a little bit about the plot of the original book, so he didn't panic just because he appeared in a place like this.
While his head was spinning, Howie on the side suddenly reminded him, "Right Ah Man, you're awake now, or else go back and report to Granny first, you've been in a coma for more than you've been waking up for less than you've been waking up for the past couple of days, Uncle Wah still concluded that you might not be able to do it, and my brother and I didn't dare to tell Granny, we just said that you're here for treatment and you can't be seen in the wind, and asked her to not come to see you for the time being. "
Qiao Wen just remembered, the original body is an orphan, grew up and grandmother dependent on each other. Grandmother opened a stall selling dry goods to make a living, the original body of this sick child to pull up, it is not easy, the original small Qiao Wen is also quite competitive, not like most of the children in the city cottage as do not learn, has been seriously study, in the school results are very good, this year exactly five graduation, but because of the economic reasons, did not go to the university, but intends to look for a serious job to support the family.
Which know that before going to submit a resume, the person fell ill, and then woke up, it became the current Qiao Wen.
Qiao Wen thought for a moment and said, "Howie, I want to go outside the city fortress to get some air first, go tell my granny that I'm fine, so that she can rest assured that it's almost time to close the gears, so you'll help her to do so by the way."
Howie said, "You're going out alone? Then how can I rest assured, what if you faint on the road and no one cares?"
Qiao Wen turned his head to look at him, curved his lips towards him and squeezed out a smile, patted his shoulder and said, "I'm fine, just don't worry, you've been taking care of me every day for the past two days and you're tired, help granny close up the stalls and go back to rest earlier."
Howie stared blankly at the person in front of him, Man was always a sad and bitter face, he could not remember how long he had not seen his smile, only to feel that with this smile, the originally cloudy sky had cleared up.
He felt that Arwen was really different, yet he still couldn't say why, he just felt very joyful in his heart for such a difference, so he subconsciously nodded and obeyed his words, "Then take care of yourself, and don't forget to go back to Uncle Hua's place to drink the medicine."
"Know."
Howie was about to turn around when Joe Man called out again, "Do you have any money on you?"
"Ten more."
"OK, give it all to me."
Witnessing the lean teenager trotting away, Jovian followed his memory in the other direction.
The city fortress was divided into two districts, the western district was where they, the good citizens, lived, while the eastern district was the gathering place of the Triad's rampant pornography, gambling and drugs, where ordinary people didn't dare to set foot in at all.
Nowadays, the society that holds this place is called the Wo Hing Society, claiming to be the orthodox of the Hong Kong Sect, and the current boss, Chiu Shan Hoi, nicknamed the Drill Mountain Leopard, or Master Leopard, is a ruthless and vicious character.
Looking at the entire Hong Kong City, less than a thousand people and Xing Society can only be regarded as a small society, but because it is not subject to police control, so the situation is very special, even if it is outside the murder and arson, as long as the escape back to the city fortress, you can get away with it, so no one dares to mess with, can be called the Hong Kong City's most arrogant society.
Because the Wo Xing Society had reigned supreme and mighty in the city fortress for many years, almost everyone was proud to join the Wo Xing Society, and a well-behaved child like Qiao Wen was simply a rare animal.
As for Chen Canaan, he is naturally a member of the Wo Hing Society.
In Qiao Wen's memory, the original body of Chen Canaan mixed gangs this is very disgusting, at first for this, the two had a big fight. Or Chen Canaan vowed to join the association is only to better protect the neighborhood collar residence, will never be involved in gambling and drugs, the two only then make up for the first time.
